status: separate external-radio case candidate; unfinished wiring, cooling and support details remain visible
notes: Base and lid use the same nominal rounded outline. The front remains at Y256. The previous rear base strip from Y-26 to Y-18 is removed.
No forward radio or trackpad relocation is used. The radio and GNSS move to an external accessory; its external electrical interface is not designed here.
All PCB files remain unchanged. The smaller fan sits beyond the center-board edge; the former circular board cutout is not used.
The USB power pair passes behind the keyboard and drops locally beneath the heatpipes. Terminal positions remain fixed. All clamp screw envelopes are included.
The USB guide rails attach to removable keyboard-carrier tabs. Endpoint seam clamps take plug pull loads. Carrier stiffness, fastener fit and dressed-harness deflection still need physical tests.
The blower outlet faces the fins and its inlet faces the base grille. Separate supports carry the fan and fin stack. The CPU clamp, materials, seals and thermal performance still need qualification.
Cell maximum thickness, trackpad/plug dimensions and panel thickness/mass still need measurement. The 11 mm cells, 5 mm trackpad and 3.5 mm panel remain assumptions or nominal listing values.
Thin panels, the keyboard carrier and hinge supports need structural design and load tests. This is not a fabrication or print release.

Two metal stop prototypes set a nominal 135 degree opening. The movement check includes that endpoint. Stop strength, fastener seating, tolerances and repeated impacts still need physical qualification.
Five SJ5344 feet add 4.1 mm nominal height. The 3.1 mm intake-gap budget includes unmeasured compression and floor-deflection allowances; verify the loaded warm assembly.
The four fan leads use a JST GH pre-crimped extension, staggered insulated splices, a carrier guide and a separate floor clamp. Dressed fit and pull, heat and electrical tests are still required.
